headline: FLASH FINDING! How were prices inflated from the field to the supermarket? Striking figures in the prosecutor's file have emerged!
summary: Tax inspection reports in an Istanbul prosecutor's file found differences between prices declared by producers and those on receipts. One tangerine declared at 6-8 lira appeared on a receipt at 28 lira.
why: Food price formation affects consumer inflation in Turkey, which is closely watched by the central bank and bond investors.
